canonical_project: DXN TAS01 (ex-TasmaNet DC2/DC3) colocation data centre
owner: DXN Limited (TAS01 Pty Ltd), sold to DADT
notes: Tier II modular colocation facility at 40-50 Innovation Drive, Dowsing Point (Tasmanian Technopark, City of Glenorchy LGA; marketed as 'Hobart data centre'); ~30-35 racks with capacity to expand to ~100; serves Tasmanian government agencies and enterprise. Acquired by DXN from TasmaNet in 2020 (AU$2.7m); DXN sold TAS01 to DADT effective 30 June 2026 (landlord consent pending); purchaser continues operating.
